title: Neighborhood Watch Groups
description: Neighborhood watch groups in Sandy City, Utah. 42 multipolygon features, mirrored as GeoParquet in EPSG:3566 (NAD83(HARN) / Utah Central (ftUS)) with Web Mercator vector tiles for display. See the [agent guide](AGENTS.md) for the schema, the coded-value lists and queries that run.

links.title: Sandy City, Utah — Municipal Open Data
Sandy City GIS, the publisher of this layer
Licence status: Sandy City states no licence

tiles.title: Neighborhood Watch Groups (vector tiles, Web Mercator)

table:columns.name: OBJECTID
table:columns.description: Esri object identifier. A row number assigned by the source geodatabase and reassigned when the layer is republished. It is not a stable key and must not be used to join across collections or across refreshes.

table:columns.name: Quadrant
table:columns.description: Sandy addressing and policing quadrant. Measured in the published file: Populated on 100% of 42 rows, 6 distinct values.

table:columns.name: Community
table:columns.description: Sandy community area the group sits in, joining to the `communities` collection.

table:columns.name: Police_Beat
table:columns.description: Police beat the area falls in, joining to the `police-beats` collection.

table:columns.name: NW_Group
table:columns.description: Name or number of the neighbourhood watch group.

table:columns.name: Alt_Area_Name
table:columns.description: Alternative name the area is known by.

table:columns.name: AreaLeader
table:columns.description: Volunteer who leads the group. Their address, email and telephone numbers were removed before publication.

table:columns.name: Color
table:columns.description: Cartographic fill index so neighbouring areas differ on the city's own maps. It carries no meaning about the area.

table:columns.name: Include
table:columns.description: Whether the city includes the group on its published map.

table:columns.name: Last_Active
table:columns.description: When the group was last recorded as active.

table:columns.name: Shape.area
table:columns.description: Polygon area computed by the geodatabase, in the square units of the source coordinate system. Recompute it from the geometry rather than trusting it, because it is not updated when a shape is edited.

table:columns.name: Shape.len
table:columns.description: Line length or polygon perimeter computed by the geodatabase, in the units of the source coordinate system. Recompute it from the geometry rather than trusting it.

table:columns.name: geometry
table:columns.description: Feature geometry, WKB encoded, in the collection's `proj:epsg` coordinate system.

table:columns.name: bbox
table:columns.type: struct<xmin: double, ymin: double, xmax: double, ymax: double>
table:columns.description: Per-row bounding box written by gpio, as a struct of `xmin`, `ymin`, `xmax`, `ymax`, in the same coordinate system as the geometry. Rows are in Hilbert order, so filtering on this column prunes row groups efficiently.
